extracted_concepts.name: Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The derivative of a function gives its rate of change.

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiation Rules
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Set of rules for computing derivatives.

extracted_concepts.name: Power Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If f(x)=x^n with n real, then f'(x)=nx^(n-1).

extracted_concepts.name: Power Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function of the form f(x)=x^n.

extracted_concepts.name: Real Exponent
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The exponent n in x^n may be any real number.

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiable Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function whose derivative exists.

extracted_concepts.name: Constant Multiple Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If c is constant and f is differentiable, then d/dx[cf(x)]=cf'(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Natural Exponential Function e^x
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The exponential function with base e; it is its own derivative.

extracted_concepts.name: General Exponential Function a^x
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: An exponential function with base a.

extracted_concepts.name: Natural Exponential Derivative Property
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: d/dx(e^x)=e^x.

extracted_concepts.name: General Exponential Derivative Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: d/dx(a^x)=a^x ln a.

extracted_concepts.name: Natural Logarithm ln a
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The natural logarithm of a, appearing as a factor in d/dx(a^x).

extracted_concepts.name: Number e
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The unique number for which lim_{h→0} (e^h-1)/h = 1.

extracted_concepts.name: Position Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The position function s(t) whose derivative is velocity.

extracted_concepts.name: Velocity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Velocity is the derivative of position: v(t)=s'(t).

extracted_concepts.name: Acceleration
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Acceleration is the derivative of velocity: a(t)=v'(t)=s''(t).

extracted_concepts.name: Second Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The derivative of the derivative of a function.

extracted_concepts.name: Cost Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The cost function whose derivative gives marginal cost.

extracted_concepts.name: Marginal Cost
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Marginal cost is the derivative of the cost function: MC=C'(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Rate of Change
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The derivative interpreted as a rate of change in physics, biology, and economics.

extracted_concepts.name: Tangent Line Approximation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Uses the derivative to estimate function values near a known point.

extracted_concepts.name: Antidifferentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The inverse operation of differentiation.

extracted_concepts.name: Integration
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Antidifferentiation; connected to differentiation by the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus.

extracted_concepts.name: Fundamental Theorem of Calculus
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Connects differentiation and integration as inverse operations.
